title: Test kit: RichAuto DSP A11 router check-sheet and air-cut to MDF test programs

body:
Create a staged test-cut kit in `docs/tester-kits/richauto-a11-router/` for mkinney's friend, following `docs/tester-kits/tormach-microarc-4th/`.

## Contents

1. **CamCraft project (`.camproj`) and pinned `.nc` files:** use short **8.3** ASCII filenames with no spaces for FAT16/FAT32 USB loading on the RichAuto DSP A11 pendant, and use one flat end mill (1/4" or 6 mm) so no mid-program tool change occurs:
   - `TEST1AIR.NC`: Stage 1 air cut (100 mm x 100 mm square contour + 50 mm circle arc pass) to test with Z0 set 25-50 mm above an empty table.
   - `TEST2CUT.NC`: Stage 2 shallow foam or MDF test coupon (100 mm x 100 mm outer `2D Contour` with 4 tabs, one 40 mm circular `2D Pocket`, one 30 mm square `2D Pocket`, and one 6 mm `Drill` hole expanded to plain moves).
2. **One-page check sheet (`README.md`):**
   - Pre-flight pendant setup checklist: `All Axes Home`, USB formatted to `FAT32`, and `MENU -> Auto Pro Setup -> G Code Setup` settings (`AbsCntr = Off`, `Read F`, `Read S`, `Ign G49`, `Ign G40`, `CodeHead`).
   - Z puck checklist: verify `MENU -> Machine Setup -> C.A.D Thickness` against calipers.
   - Step-by-step air-cut checklist, then foam/MDF cut checklist.
   - Short report table for mkinney's friend: pendant photos (`G Code Setup`, version screen), USB read status, spindle `S1`-`S8` or RPM behavior, and measured X, Y, 40 mm circle diameter, and Z pocket depth.
3. **Regression test:** pin posted `.nc` output from the `.camproj` against `richauto.cps` in `crates/app/tests/`.

## Dependencies

- Requires the RichAuto DSP A11 post sub-issue (`richauto.cps`) and confirmation of the friend's machine limits and `G Code Setup` screen on #1907 before live hardware runs.

## Done means

- `docs/tester-kits/richauto-a11-router/` holds the `.camproj`, `TEST1AIR.NC`, `TEST2CUT.NC`, and one-page `README.md`.
- A Rust integration test loads the kit project, posts it through `richauto.cps`, and matches the committed `.nc` files byte-for-byte with zero refusals.
- Hardware cut results and pendant photos from mkinney's friend are recorded on #1907 or this issue.

Part of #1907
